sentences.en: Please use this wooden box in place of a chair.
sentences.zh: 请用这个木箱代替椅子。

sentences.en: The village people built a wooden bridge across the river.
sentences.zh: 村民们在河上建了一座木桥。

sentences.en: The Horyuji is the oldest wooden building in the world.
sentences.zh: 法隆寺是世界上最古老的木结构建筑。

senses.zh: 木制的，木头的；僵硬的，呆板的；无生气的，木讷的
